caption: The drawing depicts a single object centrally positioned against a plain, off-white or beige background. The object is a square, gray-blue container or pedestal with a slightly flared top edge and a broader base, giving it a squat, block-like appearance. The gray-blue shade varies slightly in tone to suggest texture and shading. On the top surface of the container, there is a small, irregularly rounded, brownish object placed near one corner, and there appears to be a circular hole in the center of the top surface. Below this main object, the name “Violet Hurstentein” is written in neat, small handwriting. The background is otherwise empty except for two small orange-brown marks, one to the left side of the container and another near the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Pewter Inkstand
